description: Election Commission - Mr. G. E. E. Fernando of the Ja-ela Urban Council has vacated his office of member of that Ja-ela U/C
categorisation: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Ja-Ela Urban Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and local authority member status changes, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with the composition of an elected local government body, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
